items.title: Autodesk (ADSK) Brings Cloud Building Code Checks Into Forma Workflows
items.summary: Autodesk (NasdaqGS:ADSK) users gained direct access to Kestrel Labs' building code compliance engine inside Autodesk Forma through a new integration announced in November 2026.
